description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mox Diamond.
Cast Mox Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Choose to sacrifice Mox Diamond instead of having it enter the battlefield.
Repeat.
